_comment: Harness hook wiring. Key names vary by harness; the SHAPE is the point.
Both hooks exist because the behavior they enforce is otherwise
model-executed, and model-executed contracts degrade exactly when they
matter most: under long context, or after a provider chain has failed over
to a weaker tier. A hook is run by the harness and fires identically
regardless of which model is behind the endpoint.
NO CREDENTIALS IN THIS FILE. Not in a command line, not in an env block.
The hook scripts resolve secrets at runtime from the 0600 store. A
credential here would be copied into every backup of this file and, for a
prompt-submit hook, into every stored session transcript.
